name: menu
summary: The keyboard half of a menu button: where focus goes when it opens, walks and closes.

trigger.doc: The button that opens the menu; focus returns to it on Escape.

item.doc: One per entry; a disabled one is skipped.

hide.doc: Closes the menu; focus returns to the trigger if it was inside.

first.doc: Opens the menu on its first entry.

last.doc: Opens the menu on its last entry.
